prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Choose path redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 3 tests.
Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 9 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 10 tests.
Adoption layout changes have proven helpful, winning 1 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint, finish copy, finish layout, finish redesign, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across tests, with predictions on finish hints often being too optimistic.
Kinds of change tested only once, such as adoption copy and adoption incentive, still have thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path mascot carousel layout redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into an interactive carousel layout highlighting different pet creation journeys. (why: Choose path redesigns have won 2 of 3 past tests, and mean time on this screen is 514s, indicating some users hesitate when choosing a path.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet voice and sound preview new screen in adoption: Add a dedicated pet audio preview screen during adoption where users can test pet sound effects and voice clips. (why: Adoption has a steep conversion drop (72.4%). Giving users an interactive sound preview builds emotional attachment before committing.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Compact single column account sign in redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact single-column card focusing on cloud pet backup protection. (why: Sign-in mean duration is high (567s) and 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop pet interaction mode setup new flow: Add an interactive pet interaction mode selection component on the final intro screen. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple complaints from users confused about how to talk to or control their pet.)
4: [adoption, layout] Pick friend mascot carousel layout: Switch the pick friend companion selection screen layout to a carousel for browsing pet species. (why: Adoption step has the biggest initial funnel drop (72.4%). Visual carousel browsing makes selecting a companion more engaging.)
5: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign in after adoption certificate screen: Move sign-in step to occur right after completing the adoption certificate screen before pet rendering begins. (why: Moving sign-in after pet adoption commitment captures high user motivation right after adoption certificate completion.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop rendering tip display on waiting screen: Display helpful desktop interaction tips on the waiting screen while rendering takes place. (why: The waiting screen has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, while users frequently ask support how to control desktop pet features later.)
7: [finish, incentive] Desktop pet quick start mastery badge on finish screen: Add a prominent companion readiness badge component on the home intro screen. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% with total funnel completion at 34.0%; a visual completion badge encourages users to press finish.)
8: [finish, redesign] Home intro story scroll layout redesign: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a story scroll layout presenting key desktop pet shortcuts. (why: Finish screen conversion is low (64.8%) and multiple support tickets complain about unclear desktop controls post-setup.)
